text.body: catuṣṣaṣṭidaṇḍasya lakṣaṇa (sic for lakṣaṇam) divārddhena prāṇasaṃkhyā pañcasahasra 540 || evaṃ saṃkhyā gaṇitena ahorātreṇa ṣaṭśatādhika (sic) ekaviṃśatisahasrañ ca yathāsaṃkhyena gaṇitvā jñātavya ghaṭi ekena prāṇa 360 | catuḥṣaṣṭidaṇḍasya bhedaḥ samāptaḥ ||
